description.value: Handi Grill is a long-established Indian restaurant on Vancouver's West Broadway, offering award-winning traditional East Indian cuisine including Tandoori specialties, aromatic curries, and regional favourites crafted from locally-sourced ingredients. The restaurant has operated for over a decade and positions itself as a community-oriented destination rather than just a dining stop. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available, along with a full catering service for events.
